unknowns.meanwhile: Each team designs within the backend's constraints: themes Light and DarkHighContrast, zoom 100-250 %, Noto Nastaliq Urdu, status shown as text and icon, never colour alone. Follow the vendor's design principles (frontend guide 18, get_design_principles).

unknowns.question: How each realtime event is shown (interrupt, attention, inform, silent), alert sounds and which terminals play them. Only Code Red (interrupt), the licence and maintenance banners and the logout on session.revoked are prescribed (the event catalogue's `presentation`).
unknowns.meanwhile: Code Red interrupts; every other event updates the screen and, at most, a dismissible notice. `priority` is the delivery urgency, not a presentation rule.

unknowns.question: May unsaved form input be kept on the terminal (which fields, encrypted, for how long)?
unknowns.meanwhile: In memory only; never a second checker's password.

unknowns.question: The hospital's downtime procedure when the server is unreachable, and how paper records are entered later.
unknowns.meanwhile: A blocking banner, the user's input kept, no clinical or money write queued offline.

unknowns.question: Which documents may print on an unregistered terminal's default printer (sensitive A4 documents).

unknowns.question: Who approves frontend performance targets, alert thresholds and escalation timers.
unknowns.meanwhile: The server's own settings (e.g. critical_result_communicate_minutes).

unknowns.question: The labour register's columns are the hospital's own (owner decision M1, answered 15 October 2026): the defaults come from the Punjab HMIS delivery forms and the PHC manuals; a clinical lead reviews them before the hospital relies on them.
unknowns.meanwhile: Build the form from GET /maternity/labour-register/columns, never a fixed form; the hospital changes its columns on the columns screen.

unknowns.question: The blood center (owner decision B1, answered 15 October 2026; decisions 48) is built from the PBTA Standards 2015 and the Act 2016: a clinical lead reviews its minimums and workflow before a hospital relies on it. Not built: distribution to other hospitals' blood banks under contract (the Act s.10(2)(m)), apheresis collection, component quality-control sampling. Also for the reviewer: whether a partial bleed recorded Unsuccessful counts towards the donation interval (and above what volume), and how autologous donations are assessed and their units kept for their own patient.
unknowns.meanwhile: Offer the blood center screens only while the blood_center service is Active (GET /establishment); a component leaves the center only into this hospital's blood bank: offer no distribution.
